definitions: Food and drink products that have undergone extensive industrial processing and often contain high levels of sugar, salt, unhealthy fats, and artificial additives.

Industrial formulations made mostly or entirely from substances extracted from foods (oils, starches, proteins, sugars), or derived from food constituents (hydrogenated fats, modified starch, protein isolates), or synthesized in laboratories (flavor enhancers, colors, emulsifiers).
examples: Many breakfast cereals are considered ultra-processed food.
Reducing intake of ultra-processed food can improve health.
The supermarket aisle is full of ultra-processed food.
